data.one_liner: File‑ and IndexedDB‑based cache for API responses and markdown content.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to store, retrieve, and manage cached API data and markdown files with optional expiry. Supports web (IndexedDB) and mobile/desktop file systems, plus basic logging.
use_when: You want to reduce network calls by reusing previous API responses
You need simple offline access to markdown documentation
You need a quick file‑based cache without setting up a database
avoid_when: You require encrypted or secure storage
You need real‑time sync or complex relational queries
You depend on a large, actively maintained caching library
strengths: Works on all Flutter platforms including web
weaknesses: Limited to file/IndexedDB storage, no encryption

alternatives.name: flutter_cache_manager
alternatives.why_pick_it: Mature file‑based cache with eviction policies and broader community support

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simple key‑value storage for small cached items

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: Full SQLite database when you need structured, queryable cache
